slug: 2026-01-20 Africa Pushes Back On US Health Deals Over Data, Power

facts.fact: SciDev.Net reports that the US-Kenya health memorandum signed on 4 December 2025, worth US$2.5 billion, includes US support to accelerate the national rollout of Kenya's electronic medical record systems; it says the agreements generally combine US funding with domestic financing but gives no domestic figure for the record systems.

Kenya signed a memorandum with the United States on 4 December 2025 that includes support to accelerate the national rollout of its electronic medical record systems; the High Court has since halted the parts of the framework on transfer and sharing of sensitive health data, pending a hearing set for 16 February 2026.

systems.tiers: national rollout to be accelerated; no tier given

note: Regional report on the US bilateral health deals. The record systems are named generically, with no product, tier or count; the court order concerns data sharing, not the rollout itself.
